about: Brand-only supplies show a three-day Naprosyn course during Coversyl Plus LD treatment, which supplies both perindopril and indapamide.
A short oral ibuprofen course falls within both the candesartan and hydrochlorothiazide supplies in the middle of the history.
The patient has perindopril and indapamide in one tablet, and the only NSAID is a gel applied to the knee.
